title.en: Tale 10 — The Ring in the Well

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.en: Juha's ring fell in the well.
The well was deep and the water far.

sentences.ar: جحا جاب صحن لبن وكبه بالبير.
sentences.en: Juha brought a plate of yoghurt and poured it in the well.

sentences.ar: جاره شافه وسأله: شو عم تعمل؟
sentences.en: His neighbour saw him and asked: what are you doing?
Juha said: I am making yoghurt.

sentences.ar: قال الجار: البير ما بيصير لبن!
sentences.en: The neighbour said: a well does not become yoghurt!
Juha said: and if it does?
